OUR PROCESS

From discarded shell to material with a purpose.

A disciplined operating flow matters more than a good story. We are building the steps that can make shell material consistent, testable and fit for a specific use.

01
INPUT

Recover

Develop shell supply relationships with fisheries, food-service operators and recovery partners. Reliable sourcing starts with knowing the input stream.

02
PREPARATION

Prepare

Clean and reduce shell material as production capacity is established, with handling appropriate to the intended downstream use.

03
MATERIAL CONTROL

Grade

Screen material into particle-size ranges that can be evaluated against different product requirements.

04
EVIDENCE

Validate

Use laboratory work, product trials and relevant technical checks to support specifications and application claims.

05
MARKET FIT

Develop

Match validated outputs to buyer needs, formats and distribution channels. Expand only where the product and market justify it.

THE CURRENT STAGE

Building the line.
Testing the case.

Core machinery has been purchased and is awaiting shipment. An initial production location in Nassau is secured and requires preparation. Product testing and validation are the next gates before commercial release.

COMMON QUESTIONS

Good materials
need good answers.

Are BMC products available to purchase now?

Not yet. Bahama Mineral Co. is pre-commercial. We are developing poultry calcium as the first intended product and welcome expressions of interest from potential buyers.

Does every application use the same material grade?

No. Particle size, preparation and testing depend on the intended use. We will publish specifications only when a product pathway has been validated.

Are construction uses approved?

No structural or building-code claims are being made. Any construction-related use would require the relevant technical testing and approvals before commercial release.

Can we discuss shell supply or a pilot?

Yes. We welcome conversations with shell sources, researchers, farmers, designers and commercial partners while the operating system is being developed.

Useful material starts
with a better question.
